entries.m: CAN batch 1: built-in Hiworld profiles for Hyundai / Kia (HYP001, 152 cars), Toyota / Lexus ES (TYP001, 142) and Honda / Acura (HDP004, 79), each car with the car type its box needs; no car type is sent before the car is chosen.

CAN: the built-in Hiworld LNP002 profile serves its 94 cars (55 models: Renault, Dacia, LADA, Samsung, Nissan, Mercedes), each with the car type its box needs; choose yours in the CAN tab (searchable list), the Clio 3 stays the default.

CAN: the chosen car profile is written for LibreHU's TWRP too (/sdcard/TWRP/ujc201_can.conf), so that TWRP answers the box like the service (acknowledgements, Clio 3 car type) and reads the steering wheel keys of that car; the beta TWRP had the keys code but the box sent no key without it.

touchfix: answer the CAN box as its own app does, so a Hiworld box sends the steering wheel keys in TWRP: each message acknowledged (5A A5 01 FF <cmd> CS in an MCU frame 10) and the car profile's messages sent (Clio 3: car type 5A A5 02 24 00 31 56 at 1 s then every 30 s, again when the box talks after 5 s of silence).

CAN boxes of several makers, as Hiworld's app handles them: the car profile names its box family or maker, the service reads, acknowledges and writes its framing, sets the box's serial speed and reads the steering wheel keys where the profile says.

CAN box: the service answers it as the box's own app does, so a Hiworld box sends the steering wheel keys again: each message acknowledged (5A A5 01 FF <cmd> CS) and the Clio 3's car type 5A A5 02 24 00 31 56, 1 s after the start then every 30 s and again when the box comes back after a silence.
Home screen: app updates, the installed version and a check of GitHub for a newer one, then the APK (Android) or ipa (iPhone) to download, on Android and iOS.

Search bar at the top of every page: menus, groups and settings (those described to the phone app, accents ignored); a setting found is changed right in the results (switch, slider, choice, action without confirmation), Open goes to its page; in the modern and car looks.

Brightness set by hand kept after a restart: with the brightness following the headlights, a change made by the user (brightness panel, Android settings, touch keys, launcher, phone app) becomes the day or night value in use; before, the saved value was written over it when the MCU reported the headlights at start (LibreHU Helper report of 02/11: Android read 255, the service wrote right after).

TPMS on / off switch at the top of the Tyres screen and in the phone app page: off, no USB adapter is opened, no Bluetooth sensor scanned, the alarms and their sound stop and the dashboard card is hidden ("on the dashboard" only shows or hides the card).

TPMS no longer takes the OBD adapter of LibreHU-service: interfaces claimed without force first (an adapter another app holds is left to it; usb-serial-for-android's forced claim took the ELM327 from the service, both failing in a loop), an adapter that sends no TPMS frame within 15 s is given back until unplugged, and the TPMS card turns itself on only at the first TPMS frame, not when any USB-se

OBD over USB no longer fights the launcher's TPMS for the adapter: interfaces claimed without force first (an adapter another app holds is left to it, usb-serial-for-android's forced claim took it from the other connection: both failed in a loop, "Error writing 5 bytes … rc=-1"); with the automatic choice, an adapter that does not answer ELM to ATZ is skipped until unplugged.
